children: Eva Live entered a financing arrangement with Hudson Global Ventures that provides up to $10 million of equity at $2.00 per share, giving the company the right to draw capital via put notices subject to trading-based limits and an exchange cap of 7,994,828 shares unless shareholders approve more. The program depends on conditions including an effective resale registration, continued listing, and ownership limitations. To support resales, Eva Live also signed a Registration Rights Agreement requiring a registration statement filing within 30 days, initially covering warrant shares. In addition, the company issued a warrant for 275,000 shares at a $0.01 exercise price, exercisable immediately, cashless under certain conditions, expiring September 17, 2031, and subject to a 4.99% ownership cap and penny stock safeguards.
Agreement 1: Eva Live Establishes $10 Million Equity Purchase Facility at $2.00 Per Share
: Equity purchase agreement for up to $10,000,000 at $2.00 per share
: Provide flexible equity financing for working capital and growth
Agreement 2: Eva Live Enters Registration Rights Agreement to Support Investor Resale
: Registration rights agreement for resale of registrable securities
: Facilitate resale and support equity financing program
Agreement 3: Eva Live Issues 275,000-Share Warrant at $0.01, Expires 2031, to Hudson Global Ventures
: Common Stock Purchase Warrant for 275,000 shares at $0.01, expiring Sep 17 2031
: Incentivize and compensate investor supporting equity facility
